worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.summar: Pray with a loving heart over a fallen ally: raise a beacon, restore a fainted party member's real HP, and grant the loving blessing to the user and nearby allies.
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.use.0: Pray over an ally after it falls and set it back on its feet
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.use.1: Grant the loving blessing to living allies nearby
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.use.2: Mark the place of a fall with one prayer
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.descri: Prays for the nearest same-side ally that fell within %1$s blocks. A fainted member of your own party is restored to real HP at this move's revive ratio; for a wild user or no reserve, the prayer only rests on the place of the fall.
Grant the user and nearby allies a loving blessing for %1$s.
Vigil: prayer range ×1.25, blessing ×1.2 — at the cost of wind-up +4 and cooldown +40.
Brief prayer: range ×0.85, blessing ×0.9 — cheaper wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recover %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costs %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.growth: From level %1$s the prayer reaches %2$s blocks.
From level %1$s the prayer reaches %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.prefer: On: prayer range ×1.25, blessing ×1.2, wind-up +4, cooldown +40. Off (brief prayer): range ×0.85, blessing ×0.9, cheaper wind-up and cooldown.
On: only prays over a fallen ally while facing a threat. Off (default): answers a fallen ally even out of combat.
